20.143.d: तं॒ वां र॒थं वय॒म् अद्या॒ हुवेम पृथुज्र॒यम् अश्विना सं॒गतिं गोः॒ । यः॒ सूर्यां॒ व॒हति वन्धुरायु॒र् गि॒र्वाहसं पुरुत॒मं वसूयु॒म् ॥१॥
20.143.e: We invocate this day your car, far-spreading, O Asvins, even the gathering of the sunlight, Car praised in hymns, most ample, rich in treasure, fitted with seats, the car that beareth Sūryā.

20.143.d: युवं॒ श्रि॒यम् अश्विना देव॒ता तां॒ दि॒वो नपाता वनथः श॒चीभिः । युवो॒र् व॒पुर् अभि॒ पृ॒क्षः सचन्ते व॒हन्ति य॒त् ककुहा॒सो र॒थे वाम् ॥२॥
20.143.e: Asvins, ye gained that glory by your Godhead, ye Sons of Heaven, by your own might and power. Food followeth close upon your bright appearing when stately horses in your chariot draw you.

20.143.d: को॒ वाम् अद्या॒ करते रात॒हव्य ऊत॒ये वा सुतपे॒याय वार्कैः॒ । ऋत॒स्य वा वनु॒षे पूर्व्या॒य न॒मो येमानो॒ अश्विना॒ ववर्तत् ॥३॥
20.143.e: Who bringeth you to-day for help with offered oblations, or with hymns to drink the juices? Who, for the sacrifice's ancient lover, turneth you hither, Asvins, offering homage?

20.143.d: हिरण्य॒येन पुरुभू र॒थेनेमं॒ यज्ञं॒ नासत्यो॒प यातम् । पि॒बाथ इ॒न् म॒धुनः सोम्य॒स्य द॒धथो र॒त्नं विधते॒ ज॒नाय ॥४॥
20.143.e: Borne on your golden car, ye omnipresent! come to this sacrifice of ours, Nāsatyas. Drink of the pleasant liquor of the Soma: give riches to the people who adore you.

20.143.d: आ॒ नो यातं दिवो॒ अ॒छ पृथिव्या॒ हिरण्य॒येन सुवृ॒ता र॒थेन । मा॒ वाम् अन्ये॒ नि॒ यमन् देवय॒न्तः सं॒ य॒द् ददे॒ ना॒भिः पूर्व्या॒ वाम् ॥५॥
20.143.e: Come hitherward to us from earth, from heaven, borne on your golden chariot rolling lightly. Suffer not other worshippers to stay you: here are ye bound by earlier bonds of friendship.

20.143.d: नू॒ नो रयिं॒ पुरुवी॒रं बृह॒न्तं द॒स्रा मि॒माथाम् उभ॒येष्व् अस्मे॒ । न॒रो य॒द् वाम् अश्विना स्तो॒मम् आ॒वन्त् सध॒स्तुतिम् आजमील्हा॒सो अग्मन् ॥६॥
20.143.e: Now for us both, mete out, O Wonder-Workers, riches exceed- ing great with store of heroes, Because the men have sent you praise, O Asvins, and Ajamīlhas come to the laudation.

20.143.d: इहे॒ह य॒द् वां समना॒ पपृक्षे॒ से॒य॒म् अस्मे॒ सुमति॒र् वाजरत्ना । उरुष्य॒तं जरिता॒रं युवं॒ ह श्रितः॒ का॒मो नासत्या युवद्रि॒क् ॥७॥
20.143.e: Whene'er I gratified you here together, your grace was given us, O ye rich in booty. Protect, ye twain, the singer of your praises: to you, Nāsatyas, is my wish directed.

20.143.d: म॒धुमतीर् ओ॒षधीर् द्या॒व आ॒पो म॒धुमन् नो भवत्व् अन्त॒रिक्षम् । क्षे॒त्रस्य प॒तिर् म॒धुमान् नो अस्त्व् अ॒रिष्यन्तो अ॒न्व् एनं चरेम ॥८॥
20.143.e: Sweet be the plants for us, the heavens, the waters, and full of sweets for us be air's mid-region! May the Field's Lord for us be full of sweetness, and may we follow after him uninjured.

20.143.d: पना॒य्यं त॒द् अश्विना कृतं॒ वां वृषभो॒ दिवो॒ र॒जसः पृथिव्याः॒ । सह॒स्रं शं॒सा उत॒ ये॒ ग॒विष्टौ स॒र्वां इ॒त् तां॒ उ॒प याता पि॒बध्यै ॥९॥
20.143.e: Asvins, that work of yours deserves our wonder, the Bull of firmament and earth and heaven; Yes, and your thousand promises in battle. Come near to all these men and drink beside us.
